title: Petra and the Machine
author: Hazel Underhill
blurb: Jonah Dunmore, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
